parsed.notes:
Current Tech Stack is a dedicated stack section; its unmarked technologies and named technical categories are required. No section is marked optional.
Treat 'postgress' as a misspelling of PostgreSQL and 'Obsv.' and 'Eval.' as observability and evaluation.
The guide does not specify treatment of unsupported stack-category headings; literally named technical categories are retained in unmapped rather than assigned broader or speculative taxonomy skills. In particular, document pipelines are not assumed to be ETL, file storage is not assumed to be object storage, and tracking is not assumed to mean experiment tracking.
Production delivery of applied AI/ML use cases supports AI deployment. Experience as a software engineer or machine learning engineer supports the corresponding engineering skills; the alternatives remain separate required criteria under the guide.
Ownership language does not establish seniority; the stated minimum of 3+ years supports inferred mid-level seniority.
